evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/l/I.a(String[,boolean]) creates an empty R55 Sprite, records the requested resource path on that Sprite and appends it to one static pending List<Sprite> without loading pixels immediately.

rs/l/I.a() iterates the pending Sprite list, loads each <path>.png through Toolkit, resolves dimensions with ImageIcon, allocates the Sprite pixel array, grabs pixels with PixelGrabber and applies the standard non-alpha cleanup when required.

R308 CombatHudSpriteAssets registers all of its resource Sprites through this loader during static initialization; Client later invokes the loader's bulk-load method during startup after the HUD asset bundle has registered its paths.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the register-now/load-later Sprite resource loader.

evidence.detail: The class is constructed only by R22 RuneLiteSkin and retained as the button shaper installed by that skin.
It extends Substance ClassicButtonShaper and overrides getCornerRadius(AbstractButton,float) with the constant result 0.0f for every button.
The implementation has no other state or behavior beyond its synthetic RuneLiteSkin owner reference, fixing the role as the skin's square/zero-radius button shape policy.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for RuneLiteSkin's constant-zero corner-radius Substance button shaper.
